proposals.before: And king mother Lady Zhang especially favored.
proposals.after: And the king's mother, Lady Zhang, was especially favored.
proposals.reason: Literal English omits articles and the copula, obscuring that Lady Zhang was favored.
Idiomatic English inconsistently romanizes 珠崖 as Zhujia here but Zhuya in s0073–s0074.

proposals.before: In the eighth month, Grand Minister of Ceremonies Ren Qianqiu was made Fendwei General, separately leading five schools that advanced together.
proposals.after: In the eighth month, Grand Minister of Ceremonies Ren Qianqiu was made Fenwei General, separately leading five schools that advanced together.
proposals.reason: 奮威 is Fenwei; Fendwei is a corrupted romanization.

proposals.before: Zhujia commandery mountain south county rebelled, broadly consulted group ministers.
proposals.after: Zhuya commandery Shannan county rebelled; he broadly consulted the group of ministers.
proposals.reason: Literal English uses Zhujia for 珠崖 and fuses 山南縣 into an unclear phrase.

decisions.reason: 而王母張婕妤尤幸 makes Lady Zhang the patient of 幸; the missing copula in the literal leaves agency ambiguous, and the proposed wording restores that sense accurately.
乃罷珠崖 names 珠崖, already rendered Zhuya in s0073–s0074; Zhujia is a wrong romanization of the same place.
奮威將軍 is Fenwei General; Fendwei inserts an erroneous medial d and does not match 奮威.
珠崖郡山南縣反 is Zhuya Commandery’s Shannan County rebelling, not ‘Zhujia’ or a literal ‘mountain south county’; the repair restores the place names and readable structure.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 珠崖郡山南縣反，博謀群臣
